verdict.rationale: Mollie Checkout's hosted pages let the customer choose their preferred payment method from a single integration [mollie-docs-21], and Apple Pay is explicitly documented as a button option in the Magento 2 module [mollie-docs-35]. However, the pack never names Google Pay, any bank-redirect method, or any BNPL provider, so most of the requested method mix is only implied by the multi-method checkout. missing for 10: explicit Google Pay support, documented bank-redirect methods (e.g. iDEAL), documented BNPL methods, Apple Pay outside the Magento plugin, independent corroboration.
